title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
16 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-07-29 22:57:00 CDT Expires: 2026-07-29 23:45:00 CDT Urgency: Immediate Severity: Severe Certainty: Observed Instruction: For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a building. Target Area: St. Louis, MN At 1056 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Voyageurs National Park, or 24 miles east of International Falls, moving southeast at 15 mph.
HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.
This severe storm will be near... Voyageurs National Park and Rainy Lake East around 1100 PM CDT.
Other locations in the path of this severe thunderstorm include Kabetogama Lake.
